stories.headline: Australia plans stronger AI oversight
stories.summary: Australia accepted recommendations for mandatory AI incident reporting and a new regulator. Legislation is planned for next year; these are proposed changes, not enacted rules.

stories.headline: Anthropic IPO terms withdrawn as inaccurate
stories.summary: Banks briefly circulated, then withdrew, proposed IPO terms. Reuters could not establish which details were wrong. The reported fundraising figure should not be treated as final.

stories.headline: Poll favors ending Iran war and repealing tariffs
stories.summary: A Reuters/Ipsos poll found 71% support legislation ending the Iran war and 62% favor tariff repeal. The online survey covered 1,705 US adults; polling does not determine congressional action.

stories.headline: Russia and Ukraine resume US-backed talks
stories.summary: Russian and Ukrainian representatives are meeting in Abu Dhabi. US officials describe narrower differences, but the sides remain far apart and no settlement is confirmed.

stories.headline: Oil falls as Trump holds off fresh Iran strikes
stories.summary: Trump said he would hold off new strikes after regional appeals. Oil prices fell, although shipping attacks continue and oversupply concerns also weighed on prices. No ceasefire was announced.
